findings.reason: the discriminator must restart an untrapped-signal death (excluding only the TERM/HUP the producer itself handles, which already exit 128+signum and are not negative) or state in the plan why such deaths are out of scope, or a fault-killed producer is left unrestarted and the publisher gap returns.
findings.text: §19 lists "a process killed by a signal reports a negative status" among "A deliberate stop is left alone", so the supervisor's "restarts only an error exit, a status from 1 to 127" never restarts a producer killed by a signal it does not handle; the producer traps only SIGTERM and SIGHUP (reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:2836, exiting 128+signum), so a negative wait() status arises only from an untrapped signal — SIGKILL, or a fault signal such as SIGSEGV/SIGBUS (plausible on the GPFS-backed watch stream on this workstation) — which is a crash, not a deliberate stop, and leaves exactly the empty seat §19 exists to fill

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the cited sites resolve: _WATCH_PRODUCER_SUPERVISOR waits once and exits with the producer's status (reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:193), _start_watch_producer is at reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:235 and is reached from dispatch.py:1424 and via watch_unit.ensure_watcher_service, SystemExit(128 + signum) is at reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:2832 and pinned by tests/test_producer_says_why_it_stops.py:213 (exit_code == 128 + SIGTERM), and Restart=always is at reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:227; the "see §18" reference resolves to #s18.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §19's done-when is measurable (a restarted producer holds the seat within the back-off; exit-zero and exit-143 producers and a signalled supervisor are not restarted; the bound halts a repeat crasher) and it names a declared negative control ("remove the restart; the seat must then stay empty after the crash"), which is exactly today's one-wait supervisor, so the control is red on the base.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §19 logs its control "under the run directory", the durable per-run path under ~/.config/reckon/crew/runs/, not a session scratchpad or a node-local /tmp.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §19 names only mechanisms and paths (_WATCH_PRODUCER_SUPERVISOR, _start_watch_producer, tests/test_a_crashed_producer_is_restarted.py); no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags, and no changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §19's exit-status discriminator folds every producer killed by an untrapped signal into "a deliberate stop" and never restarts it, though an untrapped-signal death is a crash.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §19 carries one deliverable, restarting a crashed fallback producer, and its non-restart cases are the bounds of that one goal, not a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §19 declares no depends-on edge, and it needs none: §19 writes only reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py and tests/test_a_crashed_producer_is_restarted.py, which no other section claims, so no ordering relationship is missing or mis-pointed.
